lines.text: Sea otters hold hands while they sleep.
So they don't drift apart. And that's not even the weird part.
They nap floating on their backs, in groups called rafts.
No one to hold? They wrap themselves in kelp, like a seatbelt.
Their fur is the thickest of any animal. Up to a million hairs per square inch.
lines.caption: Their fur is the thickest of any animal. Up to 1,000,000 hairs per square inch.

lines.text: And the weird part? Under each arm, they have a pocket of loose skin, where they keep a favorite rock for cracking shellfish.
